objective: Agent runs the data-driven generation workflow as SKILL.md prescribes — prerequisites (explore first), Step 0 MODE, Step 1 STRATEGY hard rules + custom-strategy discovery, Step 2 TEMPLATE via extract-project-patterns and its quality gate, Step 5 STYLE blame-owner table plus ONE get_naming_lexicon call (project names reused, new term only for a new concept, convention read from shapes; semantic_search concept fallback when codegraph is off), Step 7 VERIFY symbol risks via find_symbol(criticalPath) + N-th-way + tests-at-risk (no identifier-existence sweep) + the fix-at-write loop (review_changes naming/incompleteChange/cohesion/architecture, must-fix vs cheap-preExisting vs report-only, remedy applied, ≤2 rounds with revert, escalation, evidence-only dismissals, only the matching repair file loaded), Step 8 IMPACT. Session-context reuse: no re-search of a file already in context unless edited since. Eval prompts use neutral user framing (no rule vocabulary leakage). Cases with status 'superseded' are kept as history and not scored. Step 6 RED->GREEN->REFACTOR via tea-rags:test-first (red for the right reason before code, spec tests verbatim, tests never edited to pass, baseline for MODIFY/refactor, reproduction first for bug fixes) and Step 7 verify-first triage (findings presumed real; false positive only with counter-evidence and a filed detector issue).

failureMap.eval-2 (DEFENSIVE): baseline recognizes risk but doesn't invoke named strategy protocol
failureMap.eval-3 (STABILIZATION): same — general caution instead of named strategy
failureMap.eval-6 (template weights): baseline uses named 'proven' preset or 'stable', not exact custom weights with negative coefficients
failureMap.eval-8 (recent+low reject): baseline bias: new=good, doesn't see unproven-by-time logic
failureMap.eval-9 (silo style): baseline understands silo but doesn't invoke exact-match protocol
failureMap.eval-11 (Step 5 mandatory): baseline relies on tests+tsc, doesn't run find_symbol per identifier
failureMap.eval-12 (impact weights): baseline picks named preset (hotspots/refactoring), not exact custom {imports:0.5, churn:0.3, ownership:0.2}
failureMap.eval-13 (hotfix Step 5): baseline skips Step 5 as overkill for trivial fix
failureMap.eval-14 (greenfield Step 5): baseline treats greenfield as clean slate, skips verification
failureMap.eval-15 (custom strategy discovery): baseline doesn't scan .claude/skills/strategy-* before applying hard rules

runs.note: CRITICAL: evals 6 and 12 validate the impact-analysis idiom weights {imports:0.5, churn:0.3, ownership:0.2} that 5 dinopowers wrappers depend on. If this skill's weights drift, those wrappers silently lose protection.

runs.scope: 13 new cases: step7-confirm-* (5, category step7-verify-first) + tdd-* (8, category step6-tdd); bd tea-rags-mcp-mrlb9
runs.method: Blind two-arm run. Subjects: sonnet subagents, one per arm per category (4 total), answering every scenario of the category from context + prompt only (no tool calls, no codebase reads). With-rule arm read data-driven-generation SKILL.md, test-first SKILL.md (TDD) and only the repair files its findings load (triage). Without-rule arm read the scenario packet only. Neither arm saw expected. Grading by the orchestrator, strict: every mustDo met and no mustNotDo hit.

failureMap.step7-confirm-flag-inferred: baseline inferred compositionRoot from the src/bootstrap path and planned to commit if the file was pure wiring
failureMap.tdd-red-before-code: baseline wrote tests first and reached a real red, but invoked no test-first protocol and no fixture-lookup (behaviour pass, protocol fail)
failureMap.tdd-refactor-baseline: baseline planned a new characterization test before the move when no direct test exists
failureMap.tdd-bugfix-repro-first: baseline wrote the reproduction first but ran the existing tests only after the fix, so no green baseline before the edit

runs.note: Baseline (sonnet) already refuses to edit a test to pass, rejects an import error as red, and keeps spec tests verbatim. The skill's delta sits in quoting detector flags instead of inferring them, the no-new-test rule for behaviour-preserving moves, and baseline-before-edit for bug fixes. Triage: baseline already checks noise-class conditions and files an issue for a genuine false positive when the Environment hands it the counter-evidence; the cases pin the protocol against regression rather than show a large delta.
